description: Says whether Uptime Kuma can watch a domain's registration expiry (domainExpiryNotification), and which domain and top-level domain it would look up. Many top-level domains have no RDAP service and cannot be watched; check before switching the notification on, since Uptime Kuma accepts it either way. Pass a monitor's ID, or an address (a URL or a host name).

address.description: A URL ("https://example.com/health") or host name ("db.example.com") to check instead

monitorID.description: A monitor whose address to check. Find IDs with listMonitors.

name: checkDomainExpirySupport

domain.description: The registered domain Uptime Kuma would look up

title: Check Domain Expiry Support
